submittedParameters.prompt: Produce ONE native square at least1024 RGBA frame. Image1 is the exact editing target, preserve its fixed canvas, rear camera, chibi head/body proportions, all hair/costume/bamboo ornament details, bow and right-shoulder quiver, and true transparent background. Image2 is an adjacent pose guide; image3 is the approved detailed hand-painted style. Do not change camera, crop, move the complete character or scale its bounding box. Rear view: screen-left is anatomical LEFT, bow hand; screen-right anatomical RIGHT, empty hand. Keep the entire long bow and string in left grip, no extra limbs. Independently redraw only the specified anatomical movement, never mirror or mechanically warp. Fix the legs for late flight approaching LEFT foot contact, just BEFORE image2. SCREEN-LEFT leg reaches DOWN toward ground, heel of left boot visible, its bottom about normalized y920, still above y940 ground. SCREEN-RIGHT knee bends behind body and the RIGHT boot is lifted HIGHER with its sole visible toward viewer, like image2 but a little higher. Do NOT repeat the current image1 opposite-leg pose. Pelvis naturally 12px higher than image2; fixed body scale. Swing the LEFT bow forearm down/back toward viewer, keep full bow tilted slightly to fit; RIGHT empty forearm swings FORWARD away from viewer and is shortened by foreshortening beside right ribs, NOT hanging behind the hip. Preserve complete left grip and rear view.
